newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan gives upbeat assessment of economy.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan gives upbeat assessment of economy.

text.p: Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan on Tuesday gave an upbeat assessment of the U.S. economy but warned of the risks of wage-driven inflation.
He also described the rise in the U.S. stock market as "breathtaking" in testimony prepared for delivery to a Senate Budget Committee hearing on the economy.
